description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'AbstractDocumentifier' used within the SuiteCRM project. The class provides an interface and common methods for converting SugarBean objects into document-oriented data structures suitable for indexing or storage. It includes methods to sanitize phone numbers, fix email fields, and serialize data, serving as a base class for concrete implementations in the search indexing subsystem.

classes.name: AbstractDocumentifier
classes.description: An abstract base class for converting SugarBean objects into document-compatible arrays, providing utility methods for sanitization and data fixing.

methods.name: documentify
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a SugarBean into an associative array suitable for document storage.

methods.name: fixPhone
methods.description: Sanitizes phone numbers in the document array by removing non-numeric characters, except for '+' sign.

methods.name: fixEmails
methods.description: Attempts to fill in the email field in the document if it is missing, using the primary email from the SugarBean.

methods.name: sanitizePhone
methods.description: Removes all non-numeric characters from a phone number string, preserving the plus sign, to improve search indexing quality.

methods.name: getMetaData
methods.description: Returns a list of common metadata fields expected in SugarBean objects.
